# Trove - National Library of Australia

> > Australia's comprehensive digital library aggregating newspapers, books, images, maps, music, archives, and research materials from libraries, museums, and cultural institutions nationwide.

Trove is managed by the National Library of Australia and includes the Australian National Bibliographic Database (ANBD), digitized historical newspapers dating back to 1803, and collaborative features for text correction and resource sharing. The platform serves researchers, historians, genealogists, and the public with access to millions of Australian cultural heritage items.

- National Library of Australia

## Core Collections

- [Newspapers](https://trove.nla.gov.au/newspaper): Australian newspaper digitization program main access page
- [Sydney Gazette](https://trove.nla.gov.au/newspaper/title/3): Sydney Gazette newspaper title page - first Australian newspaper
- [Newspaper Article View](https://trove.nla.gov.au/newspaper/article/16813670): Individual newspaper article view with paragraph editing operations

## Search and Query Documentation

- [Constructing Search Queries](https://trove.nla.gov.au/constructing-search-query-v2): Guide for constructing search queries with wildcards and operators

- [History of Trove](https://trove.nla.gov.au/about/what-trove/history): History of Trove since 2009 launch by National Library of Australia
- [Australian National Bibliographic Database](https://trove.nla.gov.au/about-australian-national-bibliographic-database-anbd): Australian National Bibliographic Database (ANBD) information page

- [Resource Sharing](https://trove.nla.gov.au/partners/partner-services/manage/resource-sharing): Trove Partners Resource Sharing (TPRS) interlibrary loan service
